reviews.summary: The changed lines are honest: free as a short note of 500 characters and a song, the medium and long letters and photos with "Make it special", and they tell the reader the 80-word letter can go free tonight. With the then/now/next method, three complete letters and the by-years table it is the page to send a friend. Polish: split the card's nested parenthetical.

Verified with noteLength (free-tier.ts) that the short letter is 379 EN / 423 ES characters and fits the 500-character note, that the medium (875/974) and long (1431/1516) letters don't, the song, "Make it special" (products.ts extras), XOXO and Keepsake premium, premium scheduling (extras.tsx), the templates against their manifests and every link. Polish: «La media» to match the lead, «pagado una vez» to match messages/es.json.

The method, by-length table, leave-out list and three full letters beat TemplateLab's list and the other top results. Fix: People also ask has "How do I wish my boyfriend for our 1 year anniversary?" and the post had no short, copyable answer under a question heading; add a 1-year FAQ in both languages.

applied: FAQ "What do I say to my boyfriend on our 1-year anniversary?" / «¿Qué le digo a mi novio en nuestro primer aniversario?», a short message that echoes the 80-word letter, in both languages.
Editor polish: «La media y la larga», «pagado una vez».
rejected: Search polish (keyword in the first H2, an exact-match title, two more internal links, an emotional-letter FAQ): polish, and this run's change is the free-tier correction.

reviews.summary: Nothing regressed; the new 1-year FAQ gives a text to send tonight and points to the short letter. Polish: split the Letter card's parenthetical.

The round-1 fix is in and well made in both languages; the FAQ now covers the 1-year People also ask question. Polish only: keyword in the first H2, exact-match title, an emotional-letter FAQ, links to the first-anniversary and long-distance posts.

applied: EN FAQ "Now I know it, and what my mother calls you".

Polish that heads off a fix: ES «Esta noche hace un año»; EN "For a letter, start from the short one above: about eighty words." / ES «Para una carta, parte de la corta de arriba: unas ochenta palabras.»

reviews.summary: Both round-3 changes check out; three full letters at 80, 200 and 300 words built on one structure, a leave-out list and delivery options make it the page to send a friend, and the product reads as one useful line.

Round-2 fix and polish made correctly; free-note facts, the 379/423-character short letter, the templates and every link verified again. Three complete letters that visibly follow one structure, a by-years table and a ready-to-send 1-year text beat a list of generic quotes. Polish: «y también cómo te llama», «un pago único».

The top results are lists of ready-made letters; this post gives the then/now/next method, a table by relationship length, a leave-out list, three complete letters and delivery options, with the 1-year People also ask question answered. Polish: links to first-anniversary-ideas-for-boyfriend and long-distance-anniversary-ideas.
